description: bob-specific exceptions to the shared tpsdev-ai preset. bob's bunfig.toml refuses versions younger than 7 days at install time (except @types/node and typescript), so advisory fixes wait the same 7 days here; an urgent fresh fix is a deliberate PR that adds the package to bunfig's minimumReleaseAgeExcludes. Lockfile maintenance is off: a lockfile refresh could move the pi runtime's transitive packages. Other update PRs regenerate bun.lock too, so review every generated lockfile diff for pi transitive changes.

packageRules.description: bob pins the pi runtime at exactly 0.84.3 on purpose: bob builds on its ModelRuntime seam, and a pi upgrade is a deliberate, spec'd PR with its own review, never a Renovate bump. The rule matches the whole @earendil-works family, so Renovate proposes no update for any of them; their transitive resolutions (pi-agent-core, pi-client, pi-protocol, pi-telemetry, pi-tui) can still move when another update regenerates bun.lock.

CodeQL rejects mixed versions across its sub-actions, so init, autobuild and analyze update as ONE PR for every update type, majors included (the shared preset groups them only for non-major updates).
